observations: Photo 0: Two white vertical desktop speakers sit side by side on a wooden table against a plain wall. The left speaker shows a "logi" logo near the bottom. The right speaker has a glowing blue power light and a volume dial at the base. A white cable runs behind them on the table.

Photo 1: The same pair of speakers from a similar angle. The "logi" logo is visible on the left unit. The right unit's blue LED is lit. A white connecting cable is visible between the units. Watermarks for "POSTED ON JIJI" and "DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED" appear across the center.

Photo 2: A close-up of the embossed label on the underside of one speaker. Readable text includes "2207 Rich Stereo Sound with Bluetooth", "Model: S-0016", "Logitech Europe S.A.", input rating "5V --- 1.5A", FCC ID, IC certification numbers, and manufacturing details.
